from: the hub, as JSON text frames on /api/v1/call and /api/v1/realtime (PROTOCOL §23.1)

heard.means: speech just ended and is being written down (the pipeline only)

user.means: what the person was heard to say

working.means: a request handed to the hive; its answer is being made

agent.means: words of the answer as they are spoken

background.means: work goes on out of the call (a work chat, or a request past realtime.waitSec); it will be said here when it ends

report.means: something that went on out of the call came back, and is said now (agent frames follow)

interrupted.means: the person talked over the answer: drop audio queued to play
